history_summary: Record five native species-reference GTDB correspondences in the seven-member space-habitat laboratory model.
history_details: Add the declared Staphylococcus capitis, Streptococcus halotolerans, Propionibacterium cyclohexanicum, Micrococcus luteus and Acinetobacter radioresistens reference correspondences, preserving all seven experimental stocks, culture deposits and original assembly strings. Species-ID populations are not direct classifications of those assemblies; rounded majority fractions are not exact numerators. Preserve the unselected Bacillus subtilis block and unresolved Pseudomonas antarctica descriptor, type-stock versus ISS/preflight origins, all source snippets and qualified cultivability/biomass claims. Only the five selected GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. The pinned table has no verified upstream release label. This bounded technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
